Development in horse rearing, production of utility types and breeds, methods of classification of horses. Social and economic important of horses, changes in the role of breeding, current use of horses, specialisation of breeds, development in the numbers of horses. (allowance 2/0)
Utility type: illustrations, practical exercises and specification. (allowance 0/2)

Principles of assessing the body structure of the horse. Principles of practical handling of horses and safety of work in horse breeding, principles of horse care, showing and evaluating horses. Mechanics of horse movements and their evaluation (allowance 2/6)

Description of the horse - principles of description, colours of horses, prepotency of colours, characteristics of horse markings, determining the age of the horse, graphical description of the horse and exercising it. (allowance 0/4)

Characteristics of the most important horse breeds - cultural warm-blood breeds, cultural heavy-horse breeds, cultural and ecological pony breeds. Horse breeding in the Czech Republic. (allowance 8/0)
Comparisons of the frame and body structure of the most important horse breeds. Organisation of horse breeding in the ČR - breeding records, stud books. (allowance 0/4)

Principles of breeding - specificities of the reproduction cycle, forms and methods of breeding, adulthood of the horse. Breeding selection and its specificities. Principles of breeding and rearing - effect of the environment, dynamics of growth of the horse. Grazing horses - principles of the establishment of pastures, organisation of grazing, ethological and ecological importance of grazing. (allowance 8/0)
Horse schooling. Horse training. Performance tests of horses. (allowance 6/0)
Identification of diseases of the horse fundament, irregularities in the mechanics of the movement of the horse. (allowance 0/4)

Methods of selection in horse breeding, prepotency of morphological and utility properties, types of phenotype selection, applying the results of performance tests to estimate the breeding value and individual selection of parents. (allowance 2/0)
Block training (excursion) (allowance 0/8)
